plugins.name: strata-workflow
plugins.description: Built on dynamic Workflows + ultracode — structured multi-agent fan-out (focus / review / sweep / panel / debate / research / scale / grow / ultra / evolve / delegate / conduct + audit) that caps agent count, reserves opus for a thin plan/advise/judge/audit layer, and spend-gates the fable apex behind delegate's escalation ladder and conduct's two orchestration endpoints. Same orchestration power, a fraction of the token burn.
